program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (cell<? a b)
      (or (< (first a) (first b))
          (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)))))
    (define (shape-key cells) (format "~a" (sort (normalize-cells cells) cell<?)))
    (define (rot90 cells)
      (let ((h (+ 1 (apply max (map first cells)))))
        (normalize-cells (map (lambda (p) (list (second p) (- h 1 (first p)))) cells))))
    (define (rotate cells k)
      (let loop ([i 0] [cur (normalize-cells cells)])
        (if (= i (modulo k 4)) cur (loop (+ i 1) (rot90 cur)))))
    (define (reflect-h cells)
      ;; Same shape, translated so its bbox starts at (0,0)
      (let* ((norm (normalize-cells cells))
             (h (+ 1 (apply max (map first norm)))))
        (normalize-cells (map (lambda (p) (list (- h 1 (first p)) (second p))) norm))))
    (define (canonical-key cells)
      (first (sort (append* (map (lambda (k)
                                   (let ((rot (rotate cells k)))
                                     (list (shape-key rot) (shape-key (reflect-h rot)))))
                                 (list 0 1 2 3)))
                   string<?)))
    ;; Mutable lookup table for groups
    (define groups (make-hash))
    (for ([obj (in-list (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 3)) (objects g 0)))])
      (hash-update! groups (canonical-key (obj-cells obj)) (lambda (xs) (cons obj xs)) (list)))
    (define odd
      (first (append* (map (lambda (k)
                             (let ((xs (hash-ref groups k)))
                               (if (= (length xs) 1) xs (list))))
                           (hash-keys groups)))))
    (if odd (paint-cells g (obj-cells odd) 8) g)))
